text_block_list.text:
One evening, while passing through the 
shopping district—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hm? What's with that crowd?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle 
is underway~! The grand prize is an 
all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg 
Steak"! 2nd prize is "Mountain of 
Carrots"! 3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the 
fun, fun lottery! Anyone and everyone, 
come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, a whole mountain of carrots? Sounds 
like a great souvenir!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Testing your luck once in a while isn't 
bad either! Let's see here—"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I see, so we need raffle tickets. I'll 
just head out and get our dinner groceries 
real quick!

Hishi Amazon finished her shopping in 
record time and returned clutching a 
single lottery ticket.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
All riiiight, here I go! Keep your eyes on 
me and expect great things!

Bursting with enthusiasm, Hishi Amazon 
spun the lottery wheel!
And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!! The Grand 
Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been 
won~~~~!!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Haaah!? Grand prize!? You've gotta be 
kidding!? What are we gonna do, Trainy?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Those guys will jump for joy if they get a 
"Hot Springs Trip Ticket"!

She seemed ready to drag along every 
single Miho resident, but if I remember 
correctly—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
“—Wait, what?! You're right, this is made 
for two!”

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Which means, um... what should we do?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know! Maybe I should give it to a 
hard-working junior? Everyone's been 
trying so hard lately, so—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"No, don't! That could start a fight! 
Maan, what a mess!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Me? Though, I'm pretty busy with 
training right now...
choice_data_list: Then let's save it as a reward for later.

text_block_list.text:
I told her she could use it however she 
liked once the Twinkle Series settled 
down. To which she replied—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I see. That way there won't be any 
fights, and it'll all get sorted out 
smoothly.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
That said, it's pairs, huh? Wonder who I 
should invite.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, I know, Trainy! Let's go together! 
A nice little getaway trip for you and me!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
What are you talking about? My partner is 
you!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Put it up in the Trainer's office or 
somethin' so ya don't forget!"

And so, there was one more thing to look 
forward to in the future.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~! The 
prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh! We did it, Trainy! That hamburger 
steak looks delicious!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure the Miho girls will love this 
too――

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"...No, this is bad. There won't be enough 
to go around for everyone at this 
rate...!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Isn't there some way we can get everyone 
to eat this...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
—That's it! I'll just memorize the flavor 
and make it myself!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Now that that's settled, time for a taste 
test! Trainy, give me a hand!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: So good...!? What even is this!?

The hamburg steak we shared and tasted was 
melt-in-your-mouth delicious.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!! The prize is a "Mountain 
of Carrots"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Alright! Just as planned! Hehehe!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
All right, with this much, we can make an 
all-carrot menu. Curry, stew—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, or maybe a carrot BBQ party 
could actually work?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Eating and drinking together... Yeah, this 
sounds like a great way to unwind!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'll give Taiki a quick shout! 
You come along too, Trainy!

That weekend, a grand BBQ party was held 
at the Miho Dormitory!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: 3rd prize~! The prize is "one carrot"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: 3rd prize?! Dammit!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
If it's just one, there's no way it'll be 
enough for their dinner.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
What should I do with this carrot? Eating 
it all by myself feels kinda boring.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...Train-boy, is there anything you wanna 
eat tonight?

That night, the two of us ate a very 
delicious curry together.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost! Your consolation prize 
is a pack of tissues~
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Wha—! A blank?! Dammit!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Well, it's a lottery. Maybe winning is 
what's actually rare."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Agh, time to switch gears! Let's head back 
already, Trainy!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*

Unfortunately, it seems luck wasn't on my 
side with the drawing today...
